Header banner for /collections/copper-peptide.

SOURCE: banner library, copper-peptide-repair-serum--D-face-full-eyes-open-right gpt_image_01 (2048x848, 2.42:1). Label checked at 100% and correct as far as it goes: Skingenetix / COPPER PEPTIDE / ADVANCED REPAIR SERUM. It is the library's abbreviated label - PREMIUM FORMULA and the 2% GHK-CU | 30ML line are deliberately out of focus per that brief - which is fine for a collection header making no dosage claim, and is NOT the garbling that had to be fixed on the homepage hero. Skin is gpt-image's and carries none of the whorl artefact the Nano Banana renders showed.

CANVAS EXTENDED, NOT CROPPED. The banner box is 100vw x 440px, so its aspect changes with the viewport - 3.27:1 at 1440, 3.44:1 at 1512, 4.36:1 at 1920 - and a 2.42:1 frame is narrower than all of them, so object-fit cover was cropping the height and taking the top of her head. Widening to 3000x848 (3.54:1) means cover now scales by height alone and the surplus width becomes croppable margin.

THE EASY CASE, MEASURED FIRST. Unlike the pdrn banner, nothing touches this left edge: the leftmost column runs mean 15.8-22.1 with a max of 25 from top to bottom, i.e. flat backdrop, so no shoulder had to be sheared out of frame. 952px of the shot's own backdrop was extended with its weave mirror-tiled and the existing vignette continued.

WHY NOT image_size 'auto'. It would show the whole frame uncropped, but it leaves the image height auto inside a grid that spans the overlaid text, so cover then crops the SIDES instead - and it makes this header taller than every other collection page. Widening the master is the fix; the script's own docstring records that trap.

object-position is right center, so horizontal cropping only ever removes the extended backdrop and never the model or the bottle.

WIDENED AGAIN AFTER MEASURING THE LIVE PAGE. The first master was 3000x848 (3.54:1) and the live banner was measured at three viewport widths: 100% of the height survived at 1440 and 1512, but only 81% at 1920, because the box is 100vw x 440px and reaches 4.36:1 there. The master is now 3750x848 (4.42:1), just past that, so the full height survives every common desktop width. Going wider costs nothing: object-position is right center, so the surplus is always cropped off the extended backdrop and never off the model or the bottle.

New filename because Shopify Files suffixes rather than replaces on a name collision. The mobile crop is byte-identical and keeps its existing handle.
